description: nextest suite. Runs the cargo tests under cargo-nextest, building the whole workspace and filtering the run to the selected packages, and leaves a JUnit report at target/nextest/<profile>/junit.xml under the workspace. Test selection is cargo's (a changed file maps to its owning package), so a nextest suite takes the same manifest a cargo suite does.

manifest.description: $PROJ-relative path to the Cargo.toml of the workspace to test, for a workspace below the repo root (e.g. "engine/Cargo.toml"). Omitted, nextest runs against whatever workspace the working directory is in.

profile.description: The nextest profile the run uses. Defaults to "tia", which the runner defines with the JUnit report enabled; a repository's own .config/nextest.toml may extend that profile or name another, as long as its junit path stays junit.xml.

cargo_args.description: Extra arguments for the build and run, one shell word per element (e.g. ["--no-default-features", "--locked"]). Defaults to none.
